scope: UX-fix: hide internal Mongo step id / __END__ sentinel suffix in MENU target picker dropdown
summary: Minimal, correct fix. New optional prop showValue (default true) gates the value-suffix span; only the two menuTargetOptions pickers opt out via :show-value="false". Tag picker (~588) and custom-field picker (~786) untouched, so their meaningful slug/field-name suffix is preserved. The default-true behavior is implemented with withDefaults rather than `props.showValue ?? true` because Vue coerces an absent declared Boolean prop to false (this was caught by the round-of-testing and fixed). No v-html introduced; option labels/values still rendered via {{ }} interpolation, so no XSS surface change. Markup/a11y (role=option, aria-selected, listbox ids) unchanged.

dimensions_checked.architecture_soc: Presentational prop; parent owns the show/hide decision. OK.
dimensions_checked.readability: WHY-comment documents the Boolean-coercion footgun and the rationale for withDefaults. OK.
dimensions_checked.type_safety: showValue?: boolean typed; no any; default true via withDefaults makes runtime value deterministic.
dimensions_checked.cross_file_consistency: Verified tag picker and custom-field picker SearchableSelect instances do NOT pass show-value, so default true keeps their suffix. Only the two menuTargetOptions pickers set false.
dimensions_checked.security: No v-html. Interpolation only. Fix narrows displayed text; no new injection path.
dimensions_checked.testing: Default-true regression test (caught the real Boolean-default bug), false-case test, plus two FunnelStepForm assertions (callback + timeout target pickers) that the raw id / __END__ no longer renders while the step number+name stays.
dimensions_checked.a11y_markup: Conditional gate added to an existing inner span; surrounding ARIA/markup unchanged.
